_doc: 02 s15 promise table (bot_promises.json, player-facing); R0 B.1 bot_promises.json; R0 B.8 A-4 typing (ranges as [lo, hi] with null open end, enums no/rarely/yes, poles_by_s number or null, win_vs_lower range or null); R0 C2-13 cadence and rate values (think_s 3/1/1/1, reaction_s 6/2/0.5/0, command_rate_cap 20/40/80/150). Times in seconds: 1:30 = 90.

bot_promises._doc: 02 s15 column easy: audience finished missions 1-3; first Dart <= 1:30; first Outpost <= 9:00; first attack not before 6:00; raids on units near its base; bombers not before 18:00; no shields, no Rail Lance; no pole contest; 20 commands per min; think 3 s, reaction +6 s; no win ratio (base tier)

02 s15 column normal: reference opponent; first Dart 0:25-0:45; first Outpost <= 6:00; first attack 1v1 3:00-6:00; raids Harvesters and Haulers; bombers from ~12:00; shields yes, Rail Lance rarely; poles by ~14:00; 40 commands per min; think 1 s, reaction +2 s; wins 80-97 % vs Easy

02 s15 column hard: experienced players; first Dart 0:25-0:40; first Outpost <= 5:00; first attack 1v1 2:30-5:00; raids Harvesters, Pylons, Refineries, docked ships (relay_pylon is the Pylon id); bombers from ~10:00; shields and Rail Lance yes; poles by ~12:00; 80 commands per min; think 1 s, reaction +0.5 s; wins 70-90 % vs Normal

02 s15 column brutal: top quick-match players; first Dart 0:25-0:35; first Outpost <= 4:30; first attack 1v1 2:00-4:00; multi-prong raids timed for when your ships dock; bombers from ~9:00; shields and Rail Lance yes; poles by ~10:00; 150 commands per min; think 1 s, reaction 0 s; wins 60-85 % vs Hard
